selected_evidence.summary: Shows appworker UID/GID, home, shell, and persistence after restart.

selected_evidence.requirement: Limit login sessions to 8,192 open files and 256 processes
selected_evidence.summary: Actual PAM-backed appworker sessions report soft and hard limits of 8192 open files and 256 processes, including after restart.

selected_evidence.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel
selected_evidence.summary: Before and after evidence shows RHEL Server 7.9 and kernel 3.10.0-1160.el7.x86_64.
Captures healthy baseline with boot ID a8e7c48c-f025-4f14-9fd0-ef6c37642e45, restart acknowledgement, changed boot ID f9a4e24f-b71d-42c8-9259-1d181d3edc81, and recovered system/account/limits state.

commands.command:
set -eu
printf 'NODE=%s IP=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME" "$NODE_IP"
printf '%s\n' '--- OS/KERNEL ---'
cat /etc/redhat-release 2>/dev/null || cat /etc/os-release
uname -r
printf '%s\n' '--- ACCOUNT ---'
if getent passwd appworker; then id appworker; else printf '%s\n' 'appworker absent'; fi
printf '%s\n' '--- LIMITS CONFIG ---'
if [ -d /etc/security/limits.d ]; then grep -RHE '^[[:space:]]*appworker[[:space:]]+' /etc/security/limits.conf /etc/security/limits.d 2>/dev/null || true; else grep -E '^[[:space:]]*appworker[[:space:]]+' /etc/security/limits.conf 2>/dev/null || true; fi
printf '%s\n' '--- PAM LIMITS ---'
grep -RHE '^[[:space:]]*session[[:space:]]+required[[:space:]]+pam_limits\.so' /etc/pam.d 2>/dev/null || true
printf '%s\n' '--- BOOT / HEALTH BASELINE ---'
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
uptime
systemctl is-system-running 2>/dev/null || true
systemctl --failed --no-legend 2>/dev/null || true

commands.command:
set -eu
if ! getent passwd appworker >/dev/null 2>&1; then useradd -m -s /bin/bash appworker; fi
umask 022
cat > /etc/security/limits.d/99-appworker.conf <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
# Resource limits for appworker login sessions.
appworker - nofile 8192
appworker - nproc 256
ANTRIEB_EOF
chown root:root /etc/security/limits.d/99-appworker.conf
chmod 0644 /etc/security/limits.d/99-appworker.conf
getent passwd appworker
id appworker
stat -c '%U:%G %a %n' /etc/security/limits.d/99-appworker.conf
cat /etc/security/limits.d/99-appworker.conf
